questions.question: The School Trip
answers: Here’s the notice about our school trip. We’re going to visit the Space Museum on September 5th, this Friday. We’ll have to leave school at 8:30, so don’t be late. We’ll get there by bus. The cost will be 40 yuan each student. And I will give you some work to do at the museum. So please remember to take a pen and a notebook.
